recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. If the work group wants the extension to exactly mirror the Jira's original CapabilityStatement.rest scope, absent-value comment, or uppercase BOTH wording, handle that as a FHIR Extension Pack follow-up.
issue_request: The ballot issue asked to require all servers to support both GET and POST search and to remove reliance on HTTP 405 as a runtime fallback. The Published / Not Persuasive with Modification resolution instead directed creation of a 0..1 code extension on CapabilityStatement.rest and CapabilityStatement.rest.resource to declare GET, POST, or BOTH support until CapabilityStatement2 handles the topic.
initial_application: No FHIR-core commit explicitly tagged FHIR-39107 was found. HL7/fhir-extensions commit 4beef02fa74740a3d4daf3c22b7d46bd0781df65 added the capabilitystatement-search-mode StructureDefinition and CodeSystem, and later extension-pack commits adjusted OIDs, value set binding, metadata, and FHIR-44374 punctuation.
additional_context: Current core source contains only OID registrations for capabilitystatement-search-mode and the HTTP/search prose that defines both GET and POST search while allowing HTTP 405 for either method but not both. FHIR-I minutes confirm the WG chose an extension rather than a mandate to remove that fallback. The Extension Pack definition now carries the declared-search-mode artifact; exact alignment questions about rest-level context or absent-value comment text belong in that repository.
reconciliation: Created an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. No core source hunk is necessary because the requested extension artifact is not actively sourced from the FHIR-core checkout.
